title: Draft rescue and evacuation guide (inverted stop, release under load)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Rescuing a rider held by tethers needs a defined sequence: support the rider, release center then sides, cut-point backup (REQ-O6, O7, H23). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Draft a rescue guide template for operators covering inverted stops, release under load, rider support, release order, cut-point backup, and coordination with the ride's own evacuation plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Every step traces to a REQ or hazard ID
Uses biomech-002 findings for rescue priority if available
Clearly a template for a ride's own procedures
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
